title: IVG Savr 3000 Watermelon Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Watermelon Ice IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods pair sweet, crisp Watermelon flavour with a streak of cool Menthol for a refreshing vape. Great for vapers who enjoy a fruity base with a brisk finish. Each pod pack includes a 2ml pod and a 4ml refill container, providing up to 3000 puffs when used with the IVG Savr 3000 Kit. No coils, no refilling — just assemble and vape. The built-in mesh coil provides consistent flavour and vapour throughout the pod’s lifespan. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
